flags: Easy days are the leak: Fri 16 32 vs 50, Sun 18 62 vs 120. Quality days overdeliver (Tue 13 115 vs 90). Sat 17 ran 2h34 / 937m (94% of time) but booked 139 vs 175: icu undercounts hiking-heavy trail, so long-day plan loads sit ~20% above what the same session books.

Sunday's pre-run e-bike (43min elapsed) pushed the run start to 07:59 and likely capped the run. Next back-to-back (Sun 25): trailhead by 07:30, no pre-ride.
